questions.question: Amit sells an item for Rs. 614.25 after offering a discount of 25% on its marked price. Had he not offered the discount, he would have earned a profit of 17%. The cost price (in Rs.) of the item is:

Selling price = Marked price - discount %

Marked price = cost price + Profit %

**Calculation:**

Let Marked price to be = 100 %

Selling price = 100% - 25 %

⇒ 75 %

According to question,

Value of 75 % = 614.25

Value of 100 % = 614.25 × 100over 75 %

Marked price ( 100% ) = 819

⇒ 819 = cost price + profit %

⇒ 819 = 100 % + 17 %

⇒ 819 = 117 %

⇒100 % = 700

**∴ The cost price of the item = Rs. 700**

questions.question: Deepthi loses Rs. 300 yearly on simple interest when the rate of interest falls from 12(1)/(2)% to 10(1)/(2)%. The amount invested by Deepthi is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate(r₁) = 12{1over2}%

Rate(r₂) = 10{1over2}%

Time(t) = 1 year

Losses of simple interest yearly = Rs. 300

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let the amount invested by Deepthi be Rs. x.

The rate of interest fall = 12{1over2}% – 10{1over2}%

⇒ (25over2 – 21over2)% = 4over2% = 2%

The rate of interest fall = 2%

Simple interest = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ 300 = (x× 2× 1)over100 

⇒ 2x = 30000

⇒ x = 30000over2 = Rs. 15000

**∴ The amount invested by Deepthi is Rs. 15,000.**

⇒ 300 = {x×1times({25over2} - {21over2})}over100 

⇒ 300 = (x× 2× 1)over100 

⇒ x = 30000over2 = Rs. 15000

∴ The amount invested by Deepthi is Rs. 15,000.

questions.solution:

Average = Sum of all the terms/Total number of terms

**Calculation:**

questions.question: The least perfect square which is divisible by each of 28,32 and 56 is:
questions.solution:

The least number which is exactly divisible by each one of the given numbers is called their LCM.

**Calculation:**

28 = 2 × 2 × 7

32 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2

56 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 7

LCM of 28, 32, and 56 = 2 × 2 ×2 × 2 × 2 × 7 = 224

Now,

To make the least perfect square multiply by 2 and 7 then,

⇒ 224 × 2 × 7

**∴ The correct answer is 3136**

questions.question: A library has an average of 240 visitors on Sundays and 150 visitors on other days. The average number of visitors per day in a month of 30 days, which begins with Monday, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A library has an average of 240 visitors on Sundays and 150 visitors on other days. The month starts with Monday and the total number of days in a month is 30 days.

**Concept: **

We have a total of 30 days. So total 4 weeks and extra 2 days.

Since the month starts on Monday. So in extra 2 days.

So, there are a total of 4 Sundays in the given month.

**Calculation:**

As per the question, the total number of Sundays in the given month is 4.

Required Average = (240 × 4 + 150 × 26) / 30

⇒ (240 × 4 + 150 × 26) / 30 = 4860 / 30

⇒ 4860 / 30 = 162

**∴ The approximate value of average number of visitors per day is 162.**

questions.question: 3% of which number is the sum of 4% of 12 and 6% of 80?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

3% of Number = 4% of 12 + 6% of 80

**Calculation:**

Let the value of the number be x.

3% of Number = 4% of 12 + 6% of 80

⇒ 3% × x = 4% × 12 + 6% × 80

⇒ 3over100 × x = 4over100 × 12 + 6over100 × 80

⇒ 3x = 48 + 480 = 528

⇒ x = 528over3 = 176

**∴ The number is 176.**

questions.question: Find the LCM of 25, 96, 108 and 225.
questions.solution:

questions.question: Three years ago, the ratio of the age of A to that of B was 8 ∶ 9. Five years hence, the ratio of the age of A to that of B will be 10 ∶ 11. If at present, C is 8 years younger than A, then the ratio of the present age of B to that of C is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of ages of A and B (3 years ago) = 8 : 9

Ratio of ages of A and B (5 years hence) = 10 : 11

C = A - 8 (C is 8 years younger than A)

**Calculation:**

C = A - 8 ----(1)

Ratio of ages of A and B at present = 8x + 3/9x + 3 = 10x - 5/11x - 5 ----(2)

⇒ 8x + 3/9x + 3 = 10x - 5/11x - 5 

∴ By cross multiplication,

⇒ 88x² - 7x -15 = 90x² -15x -15

⇒ 2x² - 8x = 0

⇒ x(2x - 8) = 0

⇒ x = 0, x = 4 (possible value)

Putting x = 4 in equation (2) we get,

A present age = (8x + 3) = 35 years 

B present age = (9x + 3) = 39 years

From equation (1) we get,

C present age = 27 years

Ratio of present ages of B and C = 39/27 = 13 : 9

**∴ The present ratio of B and C is 13 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

Ratio of ages of persons remains same at any given year.

questions.question: A train travelling at a speed of 60 km/h crosses another train travelling in the same direction at a speed of 24 km/h in 30 sec. What is the sum of lengths of the two trains?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

1st Train moving speed = 60 km/h

2nd Train moving speed = 24 km/h

Both trains move in the same direction.

**Calculation:**

As both trains move in the same direction, the relative speed of the faster train = 60 - 24 = 36 km/h

The relative speed in m/sec = 36 × ⁵/₁₈ = 10 m\sec.

Time taken = 30 sec

Therefore, distance traveled = 10 × 30 = 300 m

**∴ The combined length of the two trains is 300 m.**

questions.question: The area of a rectangular field is equal to the area of a triangular plot whose sides are 64 m, 120 m and 136 m. If the ratio of the sides of the rectangular field is 5 ∶ 3, its perimeter (in m) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of a rectangular field is equal to the area of a triangular plot whose sides are 64 m, 120 m and 136 m. 

Ratio of the sides of the rectangular field is 5 ∶ 3. 

**Concept: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13e672a3024ba6663b6f10879155ce78fd1fed990a1a2a2261a5ee4f9689dea6.png] 

Area of triangle = (1/2 × base × height)

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 (l + b)

**Calculation:**

Triangle side ratio = 64 : 120 : 136 = 8 : 15 : 17 

This is a Pythagorean triplet.

So, the area of triangle = (1/2 × 120 × 64) = 3840 m²

The area of the rectangle is 3840 m²

The ratio of the sides of the rectangular field is 5 ∶ 3. 

The side of the rectangle is 5x, 3x

The area of rectangle is 15x²

⇒ 15x² = 3840

⇒ x² = 256

⇒ x = 16

The side of the rectangle is 80, 48.

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 (80 + 48) = 256 m

**∴ The perimeter of the rectangle is 256 m.**
